releases.name: ex Starter Set Steven's Beldum & Metagross ex

description.text: Starter Set ex Steven's Beldum & Metagross ex, released on 21 February 2025 with Marnie's Morpeko & Grimmsnarl ex's: a ready-to-play 60-card deck of Steven's Pokémon, Trainer's Pokémon having come into the Scarlet & Violet series the month before with the Battle Partners expansion. Once a turn, Steven's Metagross ex's X-Boot can take a basic Psychic Energy, a basic Metal Energy or one of each from the deck and attach them to the player's Psychic and Metal Pokémon in any way they like; with both on Steven's Metagross ex and one more from the hand, it can use the 200-damage Metal Stomp at once. Steven's Carbink's Stone Palace cuts the damage Steven's Pokémon take by 30 while it is on the Bench, and the Granite Cave Stadium does the same for both players' Steven's Pokémon. Each box held a full-illustration Steven's Beldum, Steven and Beldum smiling at each other on a sunny day on their travels, along with damage counters and markers, a coin, a paper playmat showing Steven and a player's guide.
